name: Reincarnated as a Farm Girl?!: A Queen Bee's Second Life
source:
Is this really... my new life?

You've lived a good life as a honeybee queen. Feasted on royal jelly, overseen a successful hive, produced thousands of children to work for the collective good of all. All under the protective watch of The Keeper, the incomprehensible, benevolent figure that shields you from danger, famine, and worse. 

But now, your time is at an end...

Or so you thought! Awaken to a new, human existence in Reincarnated as a Farm Girl?!: A Queen Bee's Second Life. There are new foods to try, new places to see, and a chance to finally come face-to-face with the beekeeper who has watched over you all these years. But, a shadow seems to be over him as he wrestles with his own uncertain future.

Can you help him make the right choice? 

[From [url=https://dragontheorygames.itch.io/reincarnated-as-a-farm-girl-a-queen-bees-second-life]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这真的是……我的新生活吗？

作为蜂王，你过着美好的生活。享用蜂王浆，管理一个成功的蜂巢，生育成千上万的孩子，为所有人的集体利益而努力。一切都在守护者的保护之下，这个难以理解的仁慈人物会保护你免受危险、饥荒和更糟糕的情况的侵害。

但现在，你的时代结束了……

或者你是这么想的！在《转世为农场女孩？！：蜂王的第二人生》中觉醒，迎接新的人类存在。有新的食物可以尝试，有新的地方可以参观，并且最终有机会与多年来照顾你的养蜂人面对面。但是，当他与自己不确定的未来搏斗时，阴影似乎笼罩着他。

你能帮助他做出正确的选择吗？

[来自[url=https://dragontheorygames.itch.io/reincarnated-as-a-farm-girl-a-queen-bees-second-life]itch.io[/url]]
